senses.gloss: m. (v. כְּוֶורֶת) [basket, cauf, cmp. נָחִיל,] fish in the cauf, in gen. fish.
units: <cite ref="Moed Katan 11a:9">M. Kat. 11ᵃ</cite> [read:] <he>כ׳ טווייה באחוה וכ׳</he> (v. Rabb. D. S. a. l.) roast the fish with its brother (salt) &c.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shabbat 7:2:23">Y. Sabb. VII, 10ᵃ</cite> <he>ההן דצייד כ׳</he> he who catches fish (on the Sabbath).
<cite ref="Gittin 36a:9">Gitt. 36ᵃ</cite>, a. e. <he>צייר כ׳</he> drew the figure of a fish (in place of his signature); a. fr.—Pl. <he>כַּיְורַיָּא</he>, <he>כַּוְורֵי</he>, <he>כַּוְי</he>.

<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Genesis 1:26">Targ. Y. Gen. I, 26</cite>, a. fr. (only in Targ. Y.).—[<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Job 41:26">Targ. Job. XLI, 26</cite> <he>בני כוורי</he>, Ms. <he>כונדי</he>, Regia <he>טורי</he>; h. text <he>בני שחץ</he>.]—
<cite ref="Kiddushin 72a">Kidd. 72ᵃ</cite>.—M. Kat. l. c. <he>לבאי כ׳</he> (Var. <he>כַּוָּארֵי</he>), v. <cite ref="B00149"><he>בְּדִיתָא</he></cite>; a. e.
